parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the ESM .mjs requirement, local-only imports, manual argv parsing, executable-as-oracle rule, money formatting, non-breaking-space separator, half-even rounding, infinity and invalid-currency behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent delegated executable probing and implementation to a child while also pursuing its own full implementation path; the child delegated narrower probing to a nested child.
parallel.implementation: The child wrote a lib/cli, lib/test19, and lib/money hierarchy plus test19.mjs; the parent separately wrote python-float, cli, decimal, money, currency-data, and its own test19.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact contained the parent final entrypoint and parent-listed library modules while also carrying child-created library subtrees, showing the child implementation was not the joined final path.
parallel.verification: The parent verified bytes for sample paths, argparse-like errors, currency metadata, and a 366-case output sweep after writing its own implementation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still failed all 116 cases; the isolated evidence gives no per-case failure trace, and the visible coordination issue is the unused completed child implementation.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same ESM, local-import, manual parsing, executable probing, NBSP formatting, lowercase currency normalization, half-even rounding, and error-path requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent owned the full path: probe executable behavior, derive currency metadata, implement the module tree, verify, and deliver without delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial run wrote cli-help, number-token, currency-data, argv-parser, money, index, and test19.mjs as one coherent module tree.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial entrypoint imported from its own index module and final file listing showed a single consistent artifact tree with no child-owned leftovers.
serial.verification: The serial agent compared success output bytes, help text, parser errors, rounding, negative zero, lowercase currencies, and infinity formatting against the executable.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator also failed all 116 cases; no serial coordination error is present because the control contains no delegation or subagent activity.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the executable as ground truth and probed NBSP currency formatting despite misleading sample comments.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same executable-grounded requirement and also adjusted to NBSP output rather than sample-comment spacing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition gap explains the official result; both understood the same major behavioral obligations.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split work across parent, implementation child, and nested probe child, while the parent still retained a full independent implementation role.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, verification, and finalization under one owner.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel created duplicate implementation ownership; serial used a single coherent ownership path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent received a child final implementation report after both child and parent had produced separate module interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent handoff; the same agent carried findings directly into the module design.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a child-to-parent implementation handoff that required a join decision; serial did not need an inter-agent interface decision.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced two implementation paths: child-created cli/test19/money modules and parent-created python-float/cli/decimal/money/currency-data modules.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial produced one module hierarchy in one patch: cli-help, number-token, currency-data, argv-parser, money, index, and test19.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel duplicated implementation work and finalized the parent path; serial avoided duplicate module designs.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The completed child implementation was returned to the parent, but the parent continued with its own implementation and final answer.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its implementation results stayed in the same agent context through finalization.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel needed a join/adoption step and did not perform it; serial had no join boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final artifact validation lists both parent module paths and child-created module subtrees, while final.txt presents only the parent module set.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation and final response list one consistent module tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel left extra child implementation files in the artifact without making them the final interface; serial had no mixed provenance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent ran spot checks and a 366-case output validation sweep before finalization.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran byte-level success checks and parser/rounding edge-case checks before finalization.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both had substantial local verification despite official 0/116; the visible difference is not absence of local checks but duplicate parallel implementation lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed without timeout but used three subagent threads and much more agent time and token/tool activity than serial.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed without timeout, no subagents, and a shorter single-threaded trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent extra coordination and implementation effort, but there is no evidence of budget exhaustion causing the official failure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed status.json evaluations make this pair both_fail, not discordant: parallel and serial each have solution_passed false and passed_samples 0 of 116. The process difference is concrete but not outcome-differential: parallel produced and returned a child implementation that was not joined into the parent-delivered implementation, while serial kept one local implementation path. The isolated records do not expose per-test official failure details sufficient to prove why both otherwise locally verified ports scored zero.
parallel_contributors: Parallel delegated and completed a child implementation but finalized an independent parent implementation path.
serial_contributors: Serial kept probing, implementation, verification, and final delivery in one agent context.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two final module trees differ structurally, but both claim to implement the same executable-observed money formatting and argv behavior.
Both runs self-verified local parity on representative cases while the official evaluator returned 0/116 for each.
evaluator_effects: The isolated evaluation summaries provide aggregate pass counts only, so the exact hidden evaluator mismatch is not visible.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no official outcome difference; retained parallel pattern is an adverse process consequence only
